body:
Freeze the v2 business problem as an approved spec so later tickets can build it before the 18 Oct 2026 submission.

Spec: .adlc/specs/SC-014-v2-wallet-pantry-multistore.md (builds on the approved SC-001 vision; every SC-001 rule stays unless that spec lists it under Supersedes).

Scope of this ticket: the spec file only. No application code until the human approves the spec (P1 Gate 1) and it is decomposed.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The spec lints with every criterion verifiable. Verify: adlc spec-lint .adlc/specs/SC-014-v2-wallet-pantry-multistore.md
2. A premortem is recorded against the spec. Verify: adlc run p1 --ticket SC-014
title: Freeze the v2 spec: wallet, pantry from history, multi-store day plan, guided UX
